callees.name: _ingest_opencode
callees.pre_condition: rec is a dict parsed from a valid JSON object line in a raw OpenCode trace file identified by name (a string filename).
callees.post_condition: The raw trace record rec is incorporated into the State's in-memory OpenCode trace collection. The aggregate cache_window collection — pairs of (cached_tokens, total_input_tokens) — is updated to reflect cumulative token usage across all records ingested so far.
